senses.gloss: ch. same, to do one good or evil.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 24:18">Targ. I Sam. XXIV, 18</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ bot. the whole town stopped work <he>מִיגְמוֹל ליה חסד</he> in order to show kindness to him (to give him an honorable funeral).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:7">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> top <he>גָּמֵיל חיסדא</he> the charitable.

senses.gloss: to be laden with; to be bestowed. Targ. II Esth. V, 2 (Targ. I אטעינת, h. text וַתִּשָּׂא).—Y. Ḥag. l. c. לא איתג׳ ליה חסד nobody cared to attend his funeral, v. supra.
